_doc: Proven hooks (Skool CCC So2/So9: hook bank). type = shorts.py HOOKS; result = views vs the channel median once measured (YouTube Studio), null until then; own rows come from films, mech rows are mechanisms with [slots]. clips.json "hook_from" names the row a short's hook started from. Add winners from each weekly review with result and why.

hooks.text: AI mówi „gotowe”. A nic nie działa.
hooks.why: claim vs reality in 7 words; the viewer has seen it happen

hooks.text: Tabliczka z zakazem nikogo nie zatrzyma

hooks.text: AI chciało nadpisać historię projektu

hooks.text: Mój system celowo psuje mój kod

hooks.text: Na katar nikt nie robi rezonansu
